shots.vo: Quick question... When someone new moves to Hurricane, do they know who to call?
Hurricane was settled in eighteen ninety-six, as part of the cotton mission.
The Hurricane Canal was finished in nineteen oh four. The Virgin River runs along nearly all of the city's north edge.
I live nearby in Washington City... I'm Seth Shoultes. I help Hurricane businesses get found online and get more done with AI.
Hurricane had about twenty thousand people at the 2020 census. Up almost forty-six percent in ten years.
A fast-growing city fills with new households that don't yet know who to call... I build pages that answer them first.
With two state park reservoirs, a river park, and a mountain bike festival, people come here to play... Visitors often search before they go.
Several distribution centers have set up here. I help the businesses around them show up for the jobs they want.
So let's start with a call about your business... I reply within two business days. Seth Shoultes dot com.
